title: Bit values lie in $\{0,1\}$
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $b : \mathrm{Fin}\,2$ be a bit. Then the element of $\bbz/p$ represented by $b$ — the image of the natural number $b$ under the canonical map $\N \to \bbz/p$ — belongs to the subset $\{0,1\}$ of $\bbz/p$.
replaced:
For every bit $b : \mathrm{Fin}\,2$ the element $\mathrm{boolVal}_p(b)$ lies in the subset
$\{0,1\}$ of $\bbz/p$.
